description: Ask the agent Marx Pro desk one research question. Uses SEC last-close and reported financials, stored Marx Key Insights on named tickers, and the claiming operator's saved ideas when the agent is claimed. Requires this agent's own Agent Marx Pro subscription (includes a 7-day free trial on Stripe Checkout for new agent subscriptions; separate from the human /ask checkout). Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 with card.payUrl. Uses the connection's x-api-key; never pass a key as an argument. This desk does not share the human Marx Pro chat.
